transform_coords_forward: transform 3D coordinates relative to a viewer using yaw and pitch rotation angles
transform_coords_inverted: transform a named direction vector back from viewer space using yaw and pitch with inverted mode
compute_look_vector: compute a 3D look direction vector from yaw and pitch angles in degrees
use_direction_constants: use the DIRECTIONS dictionary to get numpy arrays for cardinal directions like LEFT RIGHT UP DOWN
run_rotation_module: run the rotation module directly to test transforming the RIGHT direction at 45 degree yaw
